front: Core equation of the income statement?
back: Revenue - Expenses = Net income. A multi-step statement shows gross profit, operating profit and pre-tax income on the way to net income.

front: What are the five steps of the revenue recognition model?
back: 1) Identify the contract; 2) identify performance obligations; 3) determine the transaction price; 4) allocate the price to the obligations; 5) recognize revenue when (or as) each obligation is satisfied.

front: How is percentage of completion measured under the cost-to-cost method?
back: Percent complete = costs incurred to date / total estimated costs. Cumulative revenue = percent complete x contract price; the year's revenue is the change in cumulative revenue.
Gross margin = gross profit / revenue. Operating margin = operating profit / revenue. Net margin = net income / revenue.
Separately, net of tax, below income from continuing operations. They are excluded when forecasting sustainable earnings.

front: Change in accounting policy vs. change in estimate?
back: A policy change is applied retrospectively (prior periods restated). An estimate change is applied prospectively (current and future periods only). Errors are corrected by restating prior periods.
